lines.text: After the tribulation, the sun will be darkened, the moon will not give its light, and the stars will fall.
They will see the Son of Man coming in the clouds, and He will send angels to gather His elect.
When the fig tree's branches become tender and sprout leaves, you know that winter is near.
Heaven and earth will pass away, but Jesus' words never will, and only the Father knows the day.
A man going on a journey put each servant in charge of a key and told the doorkeeper to keep watch.
